products.name: Crispy Anchovy Sambal
products.short: Crispy anchovies in slow-fried chili paste. Great with rice, eggs, bread — everything.
desc: Our first recipe and still our favourite. Fresh chili and shallots are slow-fried for three hours, then crispy anchovies go in at the end so they stay crunchy.
Keeps 2 months unopened in a cool, dry place; refrigerate after opening and use within 4 weeks.

about.title: From our home kitchen
about.lead: Little Chili Pantry started with one recipe — the sambal our family made every weekend — and friends who kept asking for a jar.
paras: Today we still cook it the same way: fresh chili, a big wok and three hours of patience. We added cookies for the festive season and banana chips because, honestly, we wanted something to snack on while stirring.
Every jar has its batch date on the label, so you always know how fresh it is.
values: Three hours over a low flame.
Cooked twice a week, never sitting on shelves.
Hampers and gift boxes for every festival.
